message: Lead scope decision for your P1 Working->Ready correction: the approved task is an audited, version-checked ledger state transition, not a process-tree termination or containment feature. The operator challenged why native cgroups/descendant reaping became prerequisites. Suspend further native containment scope expansion. Re-evaluate the original task's actual acceptance criteria and show a concrete causal counterexample if OS process proof is truly necessary; otherwise return to the smallest correct ledger-only implementation, preserving existing separate job/process safety gates unchanged and never claiming a process was terminated. Treat process containment as a separate follow-up unless necessary. Resume useful in-scope work and escalate only specific unresolved requirement ambiguity to Lead; normal clarification does not require operator approval.
